title: Music Brief
description: Music strategy and cue plan (production/story/music-brief.yaml): per-cue strategy, genre/era targeting, tempo/energy map, lyric sync points, and licensing status. Written by /music-brief during development; /smart-shot paces shot timing and /edit-plan paces cut rhythm against it.

strategy_default.description: Strategy for any moment no cue claims; individual cues override it.

cues.description: The cue plan. One entry per musical decision — a whole-piece bed, a sequence cue, or a scene-range cue.

scope.description: What part of the piece this cue owns.

type.description: whole_piece covers everything without a dedicated cue; scene_range and sequence list their scenes.

scenes.description: Scenes the cue plays under; empty for whole_piece.

strategy.description: Strategy for this cue; overrides strategy_default.

genre.description: Genre signal (e.g. "solo piano", "cool jazz") — chosen for what it says, not just how it sounds.

era.description: Era target carrying the audience's generational memory (e.g. "late 1970s").

tempo_energy.description: Tempo/energy map: the pacing contract /smart-shot times shots against and /edit-plan cuts to.

at.description: Position relative to the cut: a "m:ss" timestamp (e.g. "0:00") or a lowercase beat marker (e.g. "drop").

energy.description: Energy level at this point, 0 (stillness) to 1 (peak).

note.description: What the music is doing here and what the picture should do about it.

lyric_sync_points.description: Moments where a specific lyric must land on a specific image; empty for instrumental cues.

lyric.description: The lyric line, treated with the weight of dialogue.

image.description: The image it lands on — avoid restating the lyric; find the unexpected pairing.

scene.description: Scene where the sync point lands, once known.

shot.description: Shot where the sync point lands, once coverage exists.

diegetic.description: true if a character hears the music inside the story — a characterization choice, not a mixing note.

licensing.description: Licensing ledger, tracked from day one (rules/audio/music.md).

status.description: temp MUST be flagged and cleared or replaced before edit lock.

source.description: Where the music comes from: rights holder, composer, provider, or temp library.

license_id.description: License or contract reference once cleared.

cleared.description: true only when the rights are secured; temp cues are never cleared.

reference_tracks.description: Tracks that define the target — direction, not material to imitate.

note.description: What to take from this reference — and what to leave.

notes.description: Intent in prose — for counterpoint and song-as-concept cues, state the subtext explicitly.

strategy.description: Music strategy: song_as_concept (the track is the blueprint), counterpoint (music pulls against the visuals), support (mood-matching, the default), lyric_narrative (lyrics carry dialogue weight), minimal_solo (one instrument, silence as storytelling), none_diegetic (no score at all — scene sound carries everything; a deliberate choice, not an omission).
